AI read

The board leans bear at setup, one signal short of the bar to act on. Skew tail risk, deep contango complacency, calm before the storm, and thinning yearly highs at all-time highs are on alert together, and that profile precedes drawdowns, the one where you fade rallies rather than press longs.

To turn it into a trade you need one of the near-fires to go: semis stretched into a strong dollar, the freight recession tell, utilities beating Nasdaq, high-beta breaking versus bonds, or the composite topping divergence completing. What kills it is calm before the storm coming off alert alongside financial conditions tightening back to neutral, because then the setup you are pricing is gone.

Confluence over 8 weeks bear vs bull
Four rungs, and you only act on the top one. STAND DOWN, nothing is on. WATCH, one or two signals are true but they stand alone. SETUP, several are lining up. ACT, three of them have held for three sessions and they come from three different families, so it is not the same idea counted three times. A signal only counts once it has held three sessions, because one day in the zone is noise. Signals our lab rejected are left out of the count.
The three counts: firing = the condition is true at today's close, confirmed = it has been true 3 sessions in a row (this is what the bar counts), building = not true yet but close.
How to read each row: every signal is a checklist. Most of them need several things to be true at the same moment, so each line shows the condition, where it stands now and what it needs. A signal fires only when every box is ticked, which is why a number can sit well past its own trigger while the row still reads BUILDING. Some signals have two paths, either one arms them. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = getting close, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back.
